title: 25 K 个一组翻转链表
code:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution:
    def reverseKGroup(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        def reverse(head, tail): # head和tail从来都不动
            front = tail.next
            cur = head
            while front != tail:
                nxt = cur.next
                cur.next = front
                front = cur
                cur = nxt
            return tail, head
        
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        prev = dummy
        while head:
            tail = prev
            for _ in range(k):
                tail = tail.next
                if not tail:
                    return dummy.next
            
            nxt = tail.next
            head, tail = reverse(head, tail)
            prev.next = head
            tail.next = nxt
            prev = tail
            head = nxt

        return dummy.next
